Title: Stack
Description: A linear data structure that follows the Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) principle.
Explanation:
A Stack is a collection of elements where only the most recently added element can be removed first. Think of a stack of plates: you add to the top and take from the top.

**Operations:**
- **Push**: Add an element to the top.
- **Pop**: Remove the top element.
- **Peek**: Look at the top element without removing it.

**Complexity:**
- Push/Pop/Peek: O(1).
